title: Repository scaffold and learning log
required_evidence: README says in two sentences what this is and who it is for; Folders each carry a one-line README; glossary.md grows weekly with the source of every definition; log.md dated; commit history spread across fifty-five weeks, not one weekend

title: Enzyme dossier
required_evidence: EC number, UniProt accession, organism, fold family, subunit composition; Mechanism written out with the catalytic strategy named; kcat and KM from at least three sources, with assay conditions for each; A written judgement on which value you would use in a model and why

title: Enzyme kinetics: fitting and model discrimination
required_evidence: Weighted non-linear fit with confidence intervals, not point estimates; A figure quantifying the bias of the Lineweaver-Burk fit; Model comparison across four mechanisms with an information criterion; A written identifiability conclusion

title: Allostery and feedback regulation
required_evidence: MWC model implemented from the equations, not a curve fit; Effect of the allosteric constant and effector concentrations shown; A feedback-inhibited two-step pathway simulated to steady state; A design argument naming the intervention and what you expect to break

title: Pathway atlas
required_evidence: Every reaction elementally and charge balanced, verified by script; A consistent ledger format across all six modules; Hand-drawn or vector maps committed as images; Host differences at the anaplerotic node annotated

title: Redox balancing notebook
required_evidence: Degree of reduction computed from formulae, not looked up; Tested against at least three published fermentation data sets; Correctly identifies an omitted CO2 or H2 stream; Written interpretation of what a 95% carbon and 101% electron closure means

title: Biomass equation
required_evidence: Composition converted to mmol precursor per gram, with the arithmetic shown; Polymerisation ATP cost computed from first principles; Elemental balance verified; Every discrepancy against the published model larger than twenty per cent explained

title: Yield calculator module
required_evidence: Unit tests covering known cases including ethanol at 0.511 g/g; Both computational routes implemented and cross-checked; Cofactor-constrained cases handled with the binding constraint reported; Documented well enough for a stranger to use in two minutes

title: Data reconciliation and gross error detection
required_evidence: Redundancy analysis showing which measurements are checkable; A test statistic computed and the implicated measurement named; A worked example closing from 91% to within measurement error; A written refusal to normalise a balance rather than find the missing stream

title: Growth kinetics simulator
required_evidence: All three modes validated against analytical steady states where they exist; Joint confidence region showing the µmax-Ks correlation; Washout transition reproduced and compared with the analytical criterion; A designed chemostat series with the number of points justified

title: Genome annotation assessment
required_evidence: Annotation retrieved programmatically with the source and version recorded; Evidence-code breakdown computed and plotted; One gene traced from assignment back to its original experimental evidence; Five annotation failure modes documented with their model consequences

title: GPR logic and curation checklist
required_evidence: Deletion logic implemented from GPR strings without the library function; Agreement with the library verified across every gene in the model; Every dead-end metabolite and blocked reaction explained biologically; A written checklist with pass criteria, not a prose description

title: Subspace analysis of the stoichiometric matrix
required_evidence: Rank-nullity verified numerically on both networks; Five null space basis vectors interpreted as named pathways; Every conserved moiety identified and named; A stated conclusion on how many fluxes must be measured, and which

title: Core flux balance analysis study
required_evidence: At least five carbon sources with the ranking predicted before the model was run; ATP yields computed by hand and by model, with the discrepancy resolved in writing; Shadow prices read and interpreted for five metabolites; An assumptions section ranked by likelihood of being wrong

title: Flux variability and degeneracy study
required_evidence: Fixed, variable and correlated reactions tabulated per medium; A loop demonstrated explicitly, not merely asserted; Loopless FBA applied with the changed fluxes identified; A defended choice of post-perturbation objective

title: Deletion screen validated against experiment
required_evidence: Precision and recall computed against a named experimental data set; Every false positive and negative classified into mechanistic groups; Phase plane regions explained from stoichiometry, not from the plot; A written estimate of how many disagreements are data errors rather than model errors

title: Strain design with failure analysis
required_evidence: Coupling verified stoichiometrically by hand, not only by the algorithm; Production envelope with the coupled region identified; A written comparison concluding which design you would build; Five failure mechanisms each tied to a specific model limitation

title: Metabolomics error budget
required_evidence: Turnover times computed and sampling difficulty ranked; Error propagated through sampling, quenching, extraction and instrument; Thermodynamics recomputed with measured data; A statement of which conclusions from phase 2 survive and which do not

title: 13C metabolic flux analysis study
required_evidence: Atom mapping documented explicitly for every reaction; Forward simulation verified against a hand-worked case; Confidence intervals by both linearisation and bootstrap, compared; A deliberately induced structural error correctly diagnosed by the fit statistic

title: Kinetic model with parameter ensemble
required_evidence: Haldane relations imposed so parameters are thermodynamically consistent; Steady state verified independently of the integrator; Sensitivity spectrum spanning decades, with the interpretation written; A prediction interval for a two-fold enzyme change

title: Metabolic control analysis
required_evidence: Summation and connectivity theorems both verified numerically; Flux plotted against enzyme level over a ten-fold range, showing where linearity fails; Control coefficients recomputed after amplification to show redistribution; Optimal allocation compared against the MCA conclusion

title: Pathway construction package
required_evidence: Plasmid files committed in a standard format with every feature annotated; Primers with Tm, secondary structure check and a stated design rule; Segregational loss computed across a real seed train; Library size reconciled with screening capacity arithmetically

title: Genome editing plan
required_evidence: Guides designed with PAM, efficiency and off-target checks documented; Donor design with homology arm lengths justified; A graded knockdown designed for one essential target; Expected efficiencies quoted with their source

title: Dynamic control design
required_evidence: Sensor and regulated promoter added to the kinetic model; Stability and gain analysed, with the oscillatory region identified; Controlled and uncontrolled pathway compared under a substrate pulse; Sensor failure modes named with countermeasures

title: Enzyme engineering campaign
required_evidence: Library sizes computed for several position counts and matched to screening formats; Expected improvement per round stated with its basis; Train-test discipline specified for the ML variant, including held-out positions; A stopping criterion stated as a measurable result and a date

title: Omics integration with a genome-scale model
required_evidence: Data provenance recorded: accession, conditions, processing; Normalisation and threshold choices justified; Complexes and isozymes handled correctly in the mapping; Predictions compared with and without the constraint, including where it degraded them

title: Host comparison matrix and literature synthesis
required_evidence: At least eight hosts, each with quantitative product data; Every number sourced to a chapter or paper with its page; A product-class to host mapping table with stated reasons; A synthesis naming where the field is currently stuck, with evidence

title: Defended product and host choice
required_evidence: Three hosts compared on the properties that matter for this specific product; A yield ceiling computed from stoichiometry as part of the argument; The expected bottleneck named with the measurement that would confirm it; Abandonment criteria stated as a measurable result and a date

title: Process design and techno-economic model
required_evidence: Every number traceable to a calculation or a cited price; kLa requirement derived from the strain's own oxygen uptake rate; Scale-up criterion chosen and its consequences tabulated; Cost of goods with ±30% sensitivity on titre, rate and yield

title: Capstone dossier and research proposal
required_evidence: Closed mass and energy balances across the whole process; Every notebook runs from a clean environment on a fresh clone; A central hypothesis in one sentence, with the result that would refute it; Aim 1 naming the first experiment, the measurement and both outcomes

title: Immobilised biocatalyst: diffusion-limited design
required_evidence: Shell balance derived and solved, not quoted, for both first-order and Michaelis-Menten kinetics; Effective diffusivity estimated from a correlation with porosity and tortuosity corrections, and its uncertainty propagated; The controlling regime named with the criterion used, and the bead radius at which it changes; Apparent KM from a simulated titration on a diffusion-limited bead, with the discrepancy explained

title: External research artefact
required_evidence: A named collaborator or supervisor, and the question they asked you to work on; A question whose answer was not known to you when you started; A dated, shareable artefact: DOI, commit hash, or a letter; One page on what surprised you and what you would do next
